items.prompt: Why do duplicate minima survive one POP?

options.text: Each entry has its prefix cache
options.why: Each live entry stores its prefix minimum; after one duplicate is popped the earlier duplicate still supplies that minimum.
Discarding duplicate pushes would change stack size and future POP/TOP results.
A later push can be smaller than the bottom value, so the bottom is not always the minimum.
MIN reads the cached top minimum in constant work; it does not rescan all entries.

items.explanation: The preceding duplicate still exposes the same minimum.
